newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine Jan-May project proposals up 136 pct.
newsitem.headline: Philippine Jan-May project proposals up 136 pct.

text.p: Approved project proposals in the Philippines rose 136 percent to 177.38 billion pesos during the first five months of the year, the Board of Investments (BOI) said on Wednesday.
The BOI said in a statement project costs were 10.7 billion pesos higher than the target.
The board approved 176 new projects as well as expansion projects during the period, with the manufacturing sector receiving the most number of proposals.
In terms of equity investments, foreign companies planned to put in 18.18 billion pesos, while local firms, 52.02 billion pesos.
Projects approved by the BOI are eligible for tax and tariff incentives.
